const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('docs/reviews/audit-parallel-cal01-cal02-cal04-cal05-source-discovery-r1')
manifest=base/'inputs.sha256'
rows=[]
for n,line in enumerate(manifest.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines(),1):
    if not line.strip() or line.lstrip().startswith('#'): continue
    parts=line.split(None,1)
    if len(parts)!=2 or len(parts[0])!=64:
        print('MANIFEST_PARSE_FAIL',n,repr(line));sys.exit(2)
    rows.append((parts[0],parts[1]))
if len(rows)!=44:
    print('MANIFEST_ROW_COUNT_FAIL',len(rows));sys.exit(2)
for expected,path in rows:
    if ':' in path and path.split(':',1)[0].startswith(('f9eb4b1','6715c436')):
        ref,rel=path.split(':',1)
        p=subprocess.Popen(['git','show',f'{ref}:{rel}'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        out,err=p.communicate()
        if p.returncode or err:
            print('INPUT_READ_FAIL',path,'pid',p.pid,'exit',p.returncode,'stderr_bytes',len(err));sys.exit(2)
    else:
        out=Path(path).read_bytes()
    actual=hashlib.sha256(out).hexdigest()
    if actual!=expected:
        print('INPUT_HASH_FAIL',path,expected,actual);sys.exit(2)
print('MANIFEST_ROWS_VALID',len(rows))
for p in [base/'discovery.md',manifest]:
    b=p.read_bytes()
    b.decode('utf-8')
    print('OUTPUT_UTF8_VALID',p,'bytes',len(b),'sha256',hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest())
status=subprocess.Popen(['git','status','--short'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
out,err=status.communicate()
print('GIT_STATUS_PID',status.pid,'EXIT',status.returncode,'EOF',True,'STDERR_BYTES',len(err))
print(out.decode('utf-8'),end='')
check=subprocess.Popen(['git','diff','--check'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
out,err=check.communicate()
print('DIFF_CHECK_PID',check.pid,'EXIT',check.returncode,'STDOUT_EOF',True,'STDOUT_BYTES',len(out),'STDERR_EOF',True,'STDERR_BYTES',len(err))
if check.returncode: sys.exit(check.returncode)
